title: The run over card is a Panel P card on the shared look
why: The look book scored the run over card plain: a bare title, a huge void, no panel. Now the shared Panel P like the board page: 90% panel, 1px line, 24 and 32px padding, the 3px accent tab, centred, left aligned. Run over 32px, score 56px in the accent, rows 20px in the soft text, best moments 16px labels over 20px figures. Restyle only: words, count-up and initials untouched.
now: The run over card is a clean panel with a big score.
